leadText: High Touch! 2009 (Japanese: ハイタッチ！2009 High Touch! 2009) (ZMCP-4911) is a CD that was released in Japan on July 15, 2009. It features the fourth opening and ending of Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl, along with some songs from Arceus and the Jewel of Life.
plainText:
High Touch! 2009 (Japanese: ハイタッチ！2009 High Touch! 2009) (ZMCP-4911) is a CD that was released in Japan on July 15, 2009. It features the fourth opening and ending of Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl, along with some songs from Arceus and the Jewel of Life.

==Tracklist==
High Touch! 2009 (ハイタッチ！2009 High Touch! 2009)
Get Fired Up, Spiky-eared Pichu! (もえよ ギザみみピチュー！ Moeyo Gizamimi Pichu!)
Journey ~Antenna of the Heart~ (旅～心のアンテナ～ Tabi ~Kokoro no Antenna~)
Arrival of Arceus (アルセウス光臨 Arceus Kourin)
VS Marcus (サトシVSギシ Satoshi VS Gishin)
Towards the Future (未来へ Mirai he)
High Touch! 2009 [Original Karaoke] (ハイタッチ！2009 [オリジナルカラオケ] High Touch! 2009 [Original Karaoke])
Get Fired Up, Spiky-eared Pichu! [Original Karaoke] (もえよ ギザみみピチュー！ [オリジナルカラオケ] Moeyo Gizamimi Pichu! [Original Karaoke])
